rows.title: `@acl` — a decorator of the web platform
rows.summary: On the `exec` of a `usecase`: the session must pass this access rule; otherwise it returns `Err` without running.

rows.title: `@screen` — a decorator of the web platform
rows.summary: Makes a `stateless` or `stateful` a screen of the router: its route, the managers it creates and who may open it.
body: Makes a `stateless` or `stateful` a **screen** of the router: its route, the managers it creates and who may
| `route = "/users/:id"` | a route; `:id` is a parameter of the screen (converted to its type), the others come from the query |
| `providers = [Manager]` | creates those managers for the screen; `Manager.x()` inside its views uses them |
| `loggedIn = { forward: "/login" }` | without a session, the router goes to that path |
| `acl = { roles, permissions, forward }` | the session must pass the rule, or the router goes to `forward` |
| `notFound = true` | the screen for an address no route has |
Navigate with the screen, not the address: `goTo(UserScreen, id = 7)`, `goBack()`.

rows.title: `@state` — a decorator of the web platform
rows.summary: On a method of a `statemanager`: the method's value is emitted as that state.
body: On a method of a `statemanager`: the method's value is **emitted as that state**. A `Result` that fails emits
the `error` state. Without a body, it emits the state with its parameters.

rows.summary: On a `statemanager`: its state model (the states it emits).
body: On a `statemanager`: its **state model** (the states it emits). The manager starts in `Model.initial()`.

the states it emits, in order.

rows.title: `model` — a kind of the web platform

rows.title: `repository` — a kind of the web platform
rows.summary: The http calls of a component (in `data/`).
body: The **http calls** of a component (in `data/`). Each method **without a body** and with a verb decorator is one
request (fetch); its return type says how the response is decoded.
- The path is added to the connection's `baseUrl`; `:id` takes the parameter of that name; the other parameters go to
the query (GET, DELETE) or the JSON body (POST, PUT, PATCH).
- A `Result` method answers `Err(E(message = ...))` on a failure; another return type throws `HttpError`.
- `cache = true` keeps the answer `ttl` milliseconds (`purge<Method>()` forgets it); GET, PUT and DELETE retry
transient failures twice by themselves, `retry = n` adds attempts to the others.
- Only a `usecase` or an `aggregate` may use it (`N0301`).
Its file: `components/{component}/data/{file}.nuc` (`{component}`: the component's folder, `{file}`: the name in snake_case).
The smallest file of the kind (what `dragonfly make repository books Book` writes):

rows.title: The web platform of Dragonfly
rows.summary: The web platform: web apps in the browser through one UI library. 16 kinds, 22 decorators, 0 plugins; built by the dialects react (default: react).
body: A project of the platform is written once in Nuclear and builds with any of its dialects (`react`; `react` when none is named). Create one: `dragonfly new <name> -p web`.
- `stateless`: A view without state of its own: its parameters are its inputs, `build()` returns the elements.
- `stateful`: A view with state: its fields live while the view is shown; `setState(() => ...)` changes them and re-renders.
- `appConfig`: The configuration of the whole app (in `config/`): its connections and its global services.
- `config`: The configuration of one component (in `components/<c>/config/`): connections and services only that component uses.
- `repository`: The http calls of a component (in `data/`).
- `usecase`: One business operation: a class with `exec(...)` that returns `Result`.
- `appcomponent`: The facade of a component: the only thing other components and the screens see.
- `service`: A domain service: helpers the use cases share (mapping, rules on values).
- `aggregate`: A business aggregate: rules several use cases share, with its own dependencies.
- `statemanager`: The state of a screen: a `StateManager` whose methods emit the states of its state model.
- `statemodel`: A state model (in `state_models/`): each parameter is a state of the screen; a boolean carries no data.
- `model`: A domain model: only its fields.
- `component`: A global component (in `shared/components/`): a cross-cutting use case; a method with `@on(Event)` runs with every event of that class.
- `guard`: A custom access check (in `shared/guards/`): `canActivate()` says whether the caller may go on; used in `@acl(guards = [Name])`.
- `event`: A global event (in `shared/events/`): published with `Events.publish(ForceLogout(reason = "expired"))`, received by a `component` with `@on(ForceLogout)` or…
- `tests`: A test suite (vitest + jsdom, in `test/`): the app starts with its real config and every request is canned; `@mock([Class])` replaces a class with a mock;…
